milestones.description: A dataset was loaded
A genome or reference FASTA was loaded
The view moved (search, zoom or pan)
Peaks were scanned in the view
A peak was selected
Reads were clustered
Clusters were merged
A cluster was focused or hidden
A footprint was selected (Cmd/Ctrl+click in the reads)
A gene was selected (click it in the gene track, Shift+click for more)
A footprint was saved as a definition (Footprints > Saved)
Reads were selected (Shift+click in the reads)
A read filter was applied
A read filter was cleared
Reads were sorted
The named analysis panel was opened (e.g. panel_opened:footprint-analysis)
A dataset panel copy was added (+ in the panel header)
A DAF-seq panel was split into CT and GA panels
Primers were designed
A track was added
The session was saved
Undo was used

conditions.hint: Load a dataset first: Open in the top bar.

conditions.description: a genome or reference FASTA is loaded
conditions.hint: Load a reference first: pick a genome in the sidebar, or load a FASTA.
Load a gene annotation first (Reference Files in the sidebar).

conditions.description: peaks were detected in the view
conditions.hint: Scan for peaks first: click Scan in the toolbar.
Select a peak first: click one in the Peaks track (Cmd/Ctrl+click for more).
Cluster first: with peaks selected, click Cluster.
Select a footprint first: Cmd/Ctrl+click one in the reads.

conditions.description: at least one footprint definition is saved
conditions.hint: Save a footprint first: Cmd/Ctrl+click one, then save it in the Footprints panel.
Select reads first: Shift+click one or more reads.
Select a gene first: click it in the gene track (search for it to get there).
Apply a filter first: pick a filter rule and click Filter.

conditions.description: a dataset has more than one panel
conditions.hint: Add a panel copy first: + in the dataset panel header.

conditions.description: a panel shows only one DAF-seq strand
conditions.hint: Split by strand first: open the strand chip.

conditions.description: an extra track (BigWig, BigBed, motif) is loaded
conditions.hint: Add a track first: Tracks panel, or Open.
Design primers first: Primers panel > Design.

conditions.description: the named analysis panel is open (e.g. panel_open:cluster-detail)
conditions.hint: Open the panel from its coloured tile in the sidebar rail at the right edge (or its button in the classic strip above the reads).
